verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent, such as read-only or permission-limited Console API keys or per-agent keys. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: environment-specific SDK keys that isolate dev, staging and prod rule sets; SSO and SCIM for human user accounts; and a Docs MCP server that needs no key. None of these is permission scoping of API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
